units.source_text: 但是，杜子春仍旧如故，嘴唇动也不动。

en.t: But Toshishun remained just as he was, without even moving his lips.

units.source_text: 阎罗王见这情景，对着鬼卒们恶狠狠的说了几句，鬼卒们应了一生，马上押着杜子春往阎王殿上方飞去。

en.t: Seeing this, King Yama spoke a few fierce words to the demon guards. The guards answered with a cry, then immediately seized Toshishun and flew upward toward the hall of King Yama.
